searchText: What is the expected behavior if `maxPriorityFeePerGas` > `maxFeePerGas`? We should likely have tests for that 😅 Current specified behavior is that it will just be capped I believe. Got it. We definitely need to have a test for that if it's the case Yes, we will likely discuss that tomorrow <@456226577798135808>. The most important thing is for the actual work to be done and to have time to test, so I don't want to commit us to blocks which we'll have to change because we don't have enough time for proper testing, hence the three possible schedules.
